description: After operator confirmation, forget the selected UUID's acoustic profile and label history. Copy the exact UUID and revision from speaker.buckets. No open microphone is required. If enrollment_id is present, first remove that enrollment with speaker.remove; otherwise forgetting refuses to prevent an active enrollment silently acquiring a replacement UUID. This does not delete or relabel historical transcripts or other UUIDs. A future observation after explicit removal may create a new UUID. This is the explicit retention action when the bounded registry is full.

speaker_uuid.description: Exact UUID to forget, copied from speaker.buckets; other speakers are unchanged.

registry_revision.description: Exact current decimal revision from speaker.buckets; stale deletion refuses.

session_id.description: Optional exact current session ID; no open microphone is required.
